# File Summary

## Purpose
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

## File Format
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A header with the file path (## File: path/to/file)
  b. The full contents of the file in a code block

## Usage Guidelines
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

# Files

## File: .circleci/config.yml
````yaml
version: 2.1

jobs:
  actor-candidate-validation:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/base:stable
    resource_class: medium
    steps:
      - checkout
      - run:
          name: Install actor pipeline dependencies
          command: |
            sudo apt-get update -qq
            sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip blender libegl1 libgl1-mesa-dri python3-numpy curl git
            python3 -m pip install --user --disable-pip-version-check 'Pillow>=10,<12'
            blender --version | head -n 1
      - run:
          name: Resolve active candidate
          command: |
            set -euo pipefail
            candidate="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < config/active-actor-candidate.txt)"
            test -n "$candidate"
            mkdir -p build/actor-candidate/source
            python3 tools/sprites/resolve_actor_candidate.py "$candidate" \
              --github-env build/actor-candidate/candidate.env \
              --json-out build/actor-candidate/resolved.json
            sed 's/^/export /' build/actor-candidate/candidate.env >> "$BASH_ENV"
            source "$BASH_ENV"
            test "$ACTOR_CANDIDATE" = "$candidate"
      - run:
          name: Download and fingerprint immutable source
          command: |
            set -euo pipefail
            source "$BASH_ENV"
            target="build/actor-candidate/source/$SOURCE_FILENAME"
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 "$SOURCE_URL" -o "$target"
            test -s "$target"
            actual_size="$(stat -c%s "$target")"
            if [ "$SOURCE_SIZE" != "0" ]; then test "$actual_size" -eq "$SOURCE_SIZE"; fi
            if [ -n "$SOURCE_GIT_BLOB" ]; then test "$(git hash-object "$target")" = "$SOURCE_GIT_BLOB"; fi
            actual_sha256="$(sha256sum "$target" | awk '{print $1}')"
            if [ -n "$SOURCE_EXPECTED_SHA256" ]; then test "$actual_sha256" = "$SOURCE_EXPECTED_SHA256"; fi
            printf '%s  %s\n' "$actual_sha256" "$SOURCE_FILENAME" | tee build/actor-candidate/source/sha256.txt
            printf '{"size_bytes":%s,"sha256":"%s"}\n' "$actual_size" "$actual_sha256" > build/actor-candidate/source/fingerprint.json
      - run:
          name: Prepare Blender scene
          command: |
            set -euo pipefail
            source "$BASH_ENV"
            source_path="build/actor-candidate/source/$SOURCE_FILENAME"
            case "${SOURCE_FILENAME,,}" in
              *.blend) scene_path="$source_path" ;;
              *.fbx)
                scene_path="build/actor-candidate/source/imported-source.blend"
                PYTHONPATH=/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages SOURCE_PATH="$source_path" SCENE_PATH="$scene_path" blender -b --python-expr "import bpy,os; bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True); bpy.ops.import_scene.fbx(filepath=os.environ['SOURCE_PATH']); bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=os.environ['SCENE_PATH'])" ;;
              *.gltf|*.glb)
                scene_path="build/actor-candidate/source/imported-source.blend"
                SOURCE_PATH="$source_path" SCENE_PATH="$scene_path" blender -b --python-expr "import sys; sys.path.append('/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages'); import bpy,os; bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True); bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=os.environ['SOURCE_PATH']); bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=os.environ['SCENE_PATH'])" ;;
              *) echo "Unsupported actor source format: $SOURCE_FILENAME" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
            test -s "$scene_path"
            echo "export BLENDER_SOURCE_FILE='$scene_path'" >> "$BASH_ENV"
      - run:
          name: Inspect and resolve native actions
          command: |
            set -euo pipefail
            source "$BASH_ENV"
            blender -b "$BLENDER_SOURCE_FILE" -P tools/blender/inspect_actor_source.py -- --json-out build/actor-candidate/inspection.json
            python3 tools/sprites/resolve_actor_actions.py \
              --candidate build/actor-candidate/resolved.json \
              --inspection build/actor-candidate/inspection.json \
              --output build/actor-candidate/action-map.json
      - run:
          name: Render and normalize exact 232-frame contract
          command: |
            set -euo pipefail
            source "$BASH_ENV"
            eval "$(python3 - <<'PY'
            import json,shlex
            m=json.load(open('build/actor-candidate/action-map.json'))['resolved']
            for k,v in m.items(): print(f'{k.upper()}={shlex.quote(v)}')
            PY
            )"
            PYTHONPATH=/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages blender -b "$BLENDER_SOURCE_FILE" -P tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py -- \
              --actor "$ACTOR" --output build/actor-candidate/master512 \
              --target-height "$TARGET_HEIGHT" --ortho-scale "$ORTHO_SCALE" \
              --idle-action "$IDLE" --run-action "$RUN" --attack-action "$ATTACK" \
              --hit-action "$HIT" --death-action "$DEATH"
            test "$(find build/actor-candidate/master512 -name '*.png' | wc -l)" -eq 232
            python3 tools/sprites/normalize_actor_frames.py \
              --actor "$ACTOR" --input build/actor-candidate/master512 \
              --output build/actor-candidate/normalized96 \
              --report build/actor-candidate/qa.json \
              --contact-sheet build/actor-candidate/contact-sheet.png \
              --horizontal-anchor "$HORIZONTAL_ANCHOR"
            python3 - <<'PY'
            import json
            q=json.load(open('build/actor-candidate/qa.json'))
            assert q['pass'] is True and q['frame_count']==232, q
            PY
      - store_artifacts:
          path: build/actor-candidate
          destination: actor-candidate

workflows:
  circleci-fallback:
    jobs:
      - actor-candidate-validation:
          filters:
            branches:
              only: /^circleci-fallback-.*/
````

## File: .github/workflows/actor-candidate-validation.yml
````yaml
name: Actor Candidate Validation

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/actor-candidate-validation.yml'
      - 'config/active-actor-candidate.txt'
      - 'config/actor-candidates.json'
      - 'config/actor-candidates.d/**'
      - 'tools/sprites/resolve_actor_candidate.py'
      - 'tools/sprites/resolve_actor_actions.py'
      - 'tools/sprites/normalize_actor_frames.py'
      - 'tools/sprites/validate_actor_role_metrics.py'
      - 'tools/sprites/test_validate_actor_role_metrics.py'
      - 'tools/blender/inspect_actor_source.py'
      - 'tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: actor-candidate-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  candidate-state:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      active: ${{ steps.state.outputs.active }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: state
        name: Detect active actor candidate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          candidate="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < config/active-actor-candidate.txt)"
          if [[ -n "$candidate" && "$candidate" != "none" ]]; then
            echo "active=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Active actor candidate: $candidate"
          else
            echo "active=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Actor production queue complete; no active candidate"
          fi

  validate-candidate:
    needs: candidate-state
    if: needs.candidate-state.outputs.active == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Validate role-gate implementation
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/sprites -p 'test_validate_actor_role_metrics.py'

      - name: Resolve active candidate from config
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          candidate="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < config/active-actor-candidate.txt)"
          test -n "$candidate"
          mkdir -p build/actor-candidate/source
          python3 tools/sprites/resolve_actor_candidate.py "$candidate" \
            --github-env "$GITHUB_ENV" \
            --json-out build/actor-candidate/resolved.json

      - name: Download and fingerprint immutable source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          target="build/actor-candidate/source/$SOURCE_FILENAME"
          if [[ "$SOURCE_URL" == https://drive.google.com/* ]]; then
            python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check gdown
            gdown "$SOURCE_URL" -O "$target"
          else
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 "$SOURCE_URL" -o "$target"
          fi
          test -s "$target"
          actual_size="$(stat -c%s "$target")"
          if [[ "$SOURCE_SIZE" != "0" ]]; then test "$actual_size" -eq "$SOURCE_SIZE"; fi
          if [[ -n "$SOURCE_GIT_BLOB" ]]; then test "$(git hash-object "$target")" = "$SOURCE_GIT_BLOB"; fi
          actual_sha256="$(sha256sum "$target" | awk '{print $1}')"
          if [[ -n "$SOURCE_EXPECTED_SHA256" ]]; then test "$actual_sha256" = "$SOURCE_EXPECTED_SHA256"; fi
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$actual_sha256" "$SOURCE_FILENAME" | tee build/actor-candidate/source/sha256.txt
          printf '{"size_bytes":%s,"sha256":"%s"}\n' "$actual_size" "$actual_sha256" > build/actor-candidate/source/fingerprint.json

      - name: Install Blender and image tooling
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y blender libegl1 libgl1-mesa-dri python3-numpy
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'Pillow>=10,<12'
          blender --version | head -n 1

      - name: Prepare Blender scene
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source_path="build/actor-candidate/source/$SOURCE_FILENAME"
          case "${SOURCE_FILENAME,,}" in
            *.blend) scene_path="$source_path" ;;
            *.fbx)
              scene_path="build/actor-candidate/source/imported-source.blend"
              PYTHONPATH=/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages SOURCE_PATH="$source_path" SCENE_PATH="$scene_path" blender -b --python-expr "import bpy, os; bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True); bpy.ops.import_scene.fbx(filepath=os.environ['SOURCE_PATH']); bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=os.environ['SCENE_PATH'])"
              ;;
            *.gltf|*.glb)
              scene_path="build/actor-candidate/source/imported-source.blend"
              SOURCE_PATH="$source_path" SCENE_PATH="$scene_path" blender -b --python-expr "import sys; sys.path.append('/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages'); import bpy, os; bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True); bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=os.environ['SOURCE_PATH']); bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=os.environ['SCENE_PATH'])"
              ;;
            *) echo "Unsupported actor source format: $SOURCE_FILENAME" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          test -s "$scene_path"
          echo "BLENDER_SOURCE_FILE=$scene_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Inspect source and resolve native actions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          blender -b "$BLENDER_SOURCE_FILE" -P tools/blender/inspect_actor_source.py -- \
            --json-out build/actor-candidate/inspection.json
          python3 tools/sprites/resolve_actor_actions.py \
            --candidate build/actor-candidate/resolved.json \
            --inspection build/actor-candidate/inspection.json \
            --output build/actor-candidate/action-map.json

      - name: Render exact shared actor contract
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$(python3 - <<'PY'
          import json,shlex
          m=json.load(open('build/actor-candidate/action-map.json'))['resolved']
          for key,value in m.items(): print(f'{key.upper()}={shlex.quote(value)}')
          PY
          )"
          PYTHONPATH=/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages blender -b "$BLENDER_SOURCE_FILE" -P tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py -- \
            --actor "$ACTOR" \
            --output build/actor-candidate/master512 \
            --target-height "$TARGET_HEIGHT" \
            --ortho-scale "$ORTHO_SCALE" \
            --idle-action "$IDLE" \
            --run-action "$RUN" \
            --attack-action "$ATTACK" \
            --hit-action "$HIT" \
            --death-action "$DEATH"
          test "$(find build/actor-candidate/master512 -name '*.png' | wc -l)" -eq 232

      - name: Validate master frame envelope
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from PIL import Image
          import json
          root=Path('build/actor-candidate/master512')
          frames=sorted(root.rglob('*.png'))
          offenders=[]; empty=[]; minimum=10**9
          for path in frames:
              im=Image.open(path).convert('RGBA'); bbox=im.getchannel('A').getbbox(); rel=str(path.relative_to(root))
              if bbox is None: empty.append(rel); continue
              l,t,r,b=bbox; margins={'left':l,'top':t,'right':im.width-r,'bottom':im.height-b}
              minimum=min(minimum,*margins.values()); bad={k:v for k,v in margins.items() if v < 4}
              if bad: offenders.append({'frame':rel,'bbox':[l,t,r,b],'margins':margins,'violations':bad})
          report={'pass':len(frames)==232 and not empty and not offenders,'frame_count':len(frames),'required_margin_px':4,'minimum_observed_margin_px':None if minimum==10**9 else minimum,'empty_frames':empty,'offenders':offenders}
          Path('build/actor-candidate/master-margin.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
          print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='offenders'},indent=2))
          if not report['pass']: raise SystemExit('Candidate master-render margin QA failed')
          PY

      - name: Normalize to phone-scale contract
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/sprites/normalize_actor_frames.py \
            --actor "$ACTOR" --input build/actor-candidate/master512 \
            --output build/actor-candidate/normalized96 \
            --report build/actor-candidate/qa.json \
            --contact-sheet build/actor-candidate/contact-sheet.png \
            --horizontal-anchor "$HORIZONTAL_ANCHOR"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, statistics
          from pathlib import Path
          from PIL import Image
          qa=json.loads(Path('build/actor-candidate/qa.json').read_text())
          assert qa['pass'] is True and qa['frame_count']==232, qa
          widths=[]; heights=[]; areas=[]
          for path in sorted(Path('build/actor-candidate/normalized96').rglob('*.png')):
              bbox=Image.open(path).convert('RGBA').getchannel('A').getbbox()
              if bbox:
                  l,t,r,b=bbox; widths.append(r-l); heights.append(b-t); areas.append((r-l)*(b-t))
          metrics={'frame_count':len(widths),'median_bbox_width_px':statistics.median(widths),'median_bbox_height_px':statistics.median(heights),'median_bbox_area_px2':statistics.median(areas),'max_bbox_width_px':max(widths),'max_bbox_height_px':max(heights)}
          Path('build/actor-candidate/silhouette-metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2)+'\n')
          print('Phone QA PASS', qa['frame_count'], 'frames', metrics)
          PY

      - name: Enforce config-driven role silhouette gates
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/sprites/validate_actor_role_metrics.py \
            --candidate build/actor-candidate/resolved.json \
            --metrics build/actor-candidate/silhouette-metrics.json \
            --output build/actor-candidate/role-metric-gate.json

      - name: Upload candidate evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: actor-candidate-${{ env.ACTOR_CANDIDATE }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/actor-candidate/resolved.json
            build/actor-candidate/source/sha256.txt
            build/actor-candidate/source/fingerprint.json
            build/actor-candidate/defensive-prop-fingerprint.json
            build/actor-candidate/inspection.json
            build/actor-candidate/action-map.json
            build/actor-candidate/master-margin.json
            build/actor-candidate/qa.json
            build/actor-candidate/silhouette-metrics.json
            build/actor-candidate/role-metric-gate.json
            build/actor-candidate/contact-sheet.png
            build/actor-candidate/normalized96/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
````

## File: .github/workflows/actor-production-staging.yml
````yaml
name: Actor Production Staging

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/actor-production-staging.yml'
      - 'config/actor-candidates.json'
      - 'config/actor-candidates.d/**'
      - 'config/active-actor-candidate.txt'
      - 'config/actor-production-contracts.json'
      - 'tools/sprites/resolve_actor_candidate.py'
      - 'tools/sprites/validate_ranged_attack_readability.py'
      - 'tools/sprites/upsert_directional_actor_atlas.py'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: actor-production-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  resolve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      eligible: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.eligible }}
      candidate_id: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.candidate_id }}
      actor: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.actor }}
      atlas_root: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.atlas_root }}
      evidence_artifact_id: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.evidence_artifact_id }}
      validation_run_id: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.validation_run_id }}
      source_sha256: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.source_sha256 }}
      source_git_blob: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.source_git_blob }}
      source_commit: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.source_commit }}
      min_area: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.min_area }}
      max_area: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.max_area }}
      min_width: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.min_width }}
      max_width: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.max_width }}
      min_attack_extension: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.min_attack_extension }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}

      - id: resolve
        name: Resolve qualified active actor
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          import json
          from pathlib import Path

          candidate_id = Path('config/active-actor-candidate.txt').read_text().strip()
          if not candidate_id or candidate_id == 'none':
              print('eligible=false')
              print('candidate_id=none')
              print('actor=')
              print('atlas_root=')
              print('evidence_artifact_id=')
              print('validation_run_id=')
              print('source_sha256=')
              print('source_git_blob=')
              print('source_commit=')
              print('min_area=')
              print('max_area=')
              print('min_width=')
              print('max_width=')
              print('min_attack_extension=')
              raise SystemExit(0)
          registry = json.loads(Path('config/actor-candidates.json').read_text())
          candidates = dict(registry.get('candidates', {}))
          fragments = Path('config/actor-candidates.d')
          if fragments.exists():
              for path in sorted(fragments.glob('*.json')):
                  payload = json.loads(path.read_text())
                  for key, value in payload.get('candidates', {}).items():
                      if key in candidates:
                          raise SystemExit(f'duplicate actor candidate {key!r} in {path}')
                      candidates[key] = value
          candidate = candidates[candidate_id]
          verdict = candidate.get('verdict', {})
          production = candidate.get('production', {})
          source = candidate.get('source', {})

          actor = candidate['actor']
          status = verdict.get('status', 'candidate')
          artifact_id = verdict.get('validation_artifact_id')
          run_id = verdict.get('validation_run_id')
          eligible = status == 'qualified' and bool(artifact_id) and bool(run_id)

          print(f'eligible={str(eligible).lower()}')
          print(f'candidate_id={candidate_id}')
          print(f'actor={actor}')
          print(f'atlas_root={production.get("atlas_root", f"enemy/{actor}")}')
          print(f'evidence_artifact_id={artifact_id or ""}')
          print(f'validation_run_id={run_id or ""}')
          print(f'source_sha256={source.get("sha256", "")}')
          print(f'source_git_blob={source.get("git_blob_sha", "")}')
          print(f'source_commit={source.get("commit", "")}')
          gate = dict(production.get('role_gate', {}))
          gate.update(candidate.get('role_gate', {}))
          print(f'min_area={gate.get("min_median_bbox_area_px2", "")}')
          print(f'max_area={gate.get("max_median_bbox_area_px2", "")}')
          print(f'min_width={gate.get("min_median_bbox_width_px", "")}')
          print(f'max_width={gate.get("max_median_bbox_width_px", "")}')
          print(f'min_attack_extension={gate.get("minimum_forward_attack_extension_px", "")}')
          print(f'Active candidate {candidate_id}: status={status}, eligible={eligible}')
          PY

  stage:
    needs: resolve
    if: needs.resolve.outputs.eligible == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - name: Checkout candidate PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download immutable validation evidence
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.evidence_artifact_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          run-id: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.validation_run_id }}
          path: actor-evidence

      - name: Install atlas and role-gate tooling
        run: python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'Pillow>=10,<12'

      - name: Validate evidence and configured role gate
        env:
          ACTOR: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}
          SOURCE_SHA256: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.source_sha256 }}
          MIN_AREA: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.min_area }}
          MAX_AREA: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.max_area }}
          MIN_WIDTH: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.min_width }}
          MAX_WIDTH: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.max_width }}
          MIN_ATTACK_EXTENSION: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.min_attack_extension }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$(find actor-evidence -type d -name normalized96 -print -quit)"
          qa="$(find actor-evidence -type f -name qa.json -print -quit)"
          margin="$(find actor-evidence -type f -name master-margin.json -print -quit)"
          metrics="$(find actor-evidence -type f -name silhouette-metrics.json -print -quit)"
          fingerprint="$(find actor-evidence -type f -name fingerprint.json -print -quit)"
          test -n "$root" -a -n "$qa" -a -n "$margin" -a -n "$metrics" -a -n "$fingerprint"
          python3 - "$qa" "$margin" "$metrics" "$fingerprint" <<'PY'
          import json, os, sys
          qa=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          margin=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
          metrics=json.load(open(sys.argv[3]))
          fp=json.load(open(sys.argv[4]))
          actor=os.environ['ACTOR']
          assert qa.get('actor') == actor, qa
          assert qa.get('pass') is True and qa.get('frame_count') == 232, qa
          assert qa.get('horizontal_anchor') == 'union-center', qa
          assert margin.get('pass') is True and margin.get('frame_count') == 232, margin
          assert margin.get('minimum_observed_margin_px', 0) >= 4, margin
          expected_sha=os.environ.get('SOURCE_SHA256','').strip()
          if expected_sha:
              assert fp.get('sha256') == expected_sha, (fp, expected_sha)
          assert metrics.get('frame_count') == 232, metrics
          area=float(metrics.get('median_bbox_area_px2',0))
          width=float(metrics.get('median_bbox_width_px',0))
          for key,value,op in (
              ('MIN_AREA',area,'min'),('MAX_AREA',area,'max'),
              ('MIN_WIDTH',width,'min'),('MAX_WIDTH',width,'max')):
              raw=os.environ.get(key,'').strip()
              if not raw: continue
              limit=float(raw)
              assert value >= limit if op == 'min' else value <= limit, (key,value,limit)
          print('Actor structural role gate PASS:', actor, metrics)
          PY
          if [[ "$ACTOR" == "ranged" && -n "${MIN_ATTACK_EXTENSION:-}" ]]; then
            python3 tools/sprites/validate_ranged_attack_readability.py \
              --input "$root" \
              --report build/ranged-readability.json \
              --minimum-extension-px "$MIN_ATTACK_EXTENSION"
          fi
          echo "SPRITE_ROOT=$root" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "QA_FILE=$qa" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "MARGIN_FILE=$margin" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "METRICS_FILE=$metrics" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "FINGERPRINT_FILE=$fingerprint" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build additive production actor page
        env:
          ACTOR: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}
          ATLAS_ROOT: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.atlas_root }}
          VALIDATION_RUN_ID: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.validation_run_id }}
          VALIDATION_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.evidence_artifact_id }}
          SOURCE_GIT_BLOB: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.source_git_blob }}
          SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.source_commit }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="build/${ACTOR}-production"
          mkdir -p "$out"
          cp assets/art/game.atlas "$out/game.atlas"
          python3 tools/sprites/upsert_directional_actor_atlas.py \
            --actor "$ACTOR" \
            --root "$ATLAS_ROOT" \
            --input "$SPRITE_ROOT" \
            --atlas "$out/game.atlas" \
            --png "$out/${ACTOR}.png" \
            --manifest "$out/${ACTOR}-manifest.json" \
            --source-run-id "$VALIDATION_RUN_ID"
          python3 - "$out/${ACTOR}-manifest.json" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, os, sys
          p=Path(sys.argv[1])
          data=json.loads(p.read_text())
          qa=json.load(open(os.environ['QA_FILE']))
          margin=json.load(open(os.environ['MARGIN_FILE']))
          metrics=json.load(open(os.environ['METRICS_FILE']))
          fp=json.load(open(os.environ['FINGERPRINT_FILE']))
          existing_manifest=Path(f'assets/art/{os.environ["ACTOR"]}-manifest.json')
          existing={}
          if existing_manifest.exists():
              try:
                  existing=json.loads(existing_manifest.read_text())
              except Exception:
                  existing={}
          data.update({
            'source_stage':'96px-normalization-v2',
            'source_production_ready':False,
            'source_horizontal_anchor':qa.get('horizontal_anchor'),
            'source_sha256':fp.get('sha256'),
            'source_git_blob':os.environ.get('SOURCE_GIT_BLOB') or None,
            'source_mirror_commit':os.environ.get('SOURCE_COMMIT') or None,
            'validation_run':int(os.environ['VALIDATION_RUN_ID']),
            'validation_artifact_id':int(os.environ['VALIDATION_ARTIFACT_ID']),
            'master_minimum_margin_px':margin.get('minimum_observed_margin_px'),
            'median_bbox_area_px2':metrics.get('median_bbox_area_px2'),
            'median_bbox_width_px':metrics.get('median_bbox_width_px'),
            'phone_qa_pass':True,
            'android_accepted':bool(existing.get('android_accepted', False)),
          })
          # Keep staging idempotent. upsert_directional_actor_atlas reports whether it
          # replaced a page during generation, but that transient fact must not make
          # the committed manifest differ on every subsequent workflow run.
          data['atlas_page_replaced']=False
          for key in ('source_production_ready','android_runtime_run_id',
                      'android_visual_artifact_id','android_visual_artifact_digest',
                      'android_visual_qa_pass'):
              if key in existing:
                  data[key]=existing[key]
          readability=Path('build/ranged-readability.json')
          if readability.exists():
              data['ranged_attack_readability']=json.loads(readability.read_text())
          p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
          PY

      - name: Verify accepted actors plus staged candidate
        env:
          ACTOR: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}
          ATLAS_ROOT: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.atlas_root }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, os
          actor=os.environ['ACTOR']
          candidate_root=os.environ['ATLAS_ROOT']
          atlas=Path(f'build/{actor}-production/game.atlas').read_text()
          contract=json.loads(Path('config/actor-production-contracts.json').read_text())
          dirs=contract['frame_contract']['directions']
          anims=contract['frame_contract']['animations']
          root_pages=[]
          for name, entry in contract['actors'].items():
              if entry.get('status') != 'accepted':
                  continue
              published_png=entry.get('published_png')
              assert published_png, (name, 'missing published_png')
              root_pages.append((entry['atlas_root'], Path(published_png).name))
          if candidate_root not in {root for root, _ in root_pages}:
              root_pages.append((candidate_root, f'{actor}.png'))
          for root, page in root_pages:
              total=0
              for direction in dirs:
                  for anim,count in anims.items():
                      got=atlas.count(f'{root}/{direction}/{anim}\n')
                      assert got == count, (root,direction,anim,got,count)
                      total += got
              assert total == contract['frame_contract']['total_frames'], (root,total)
              assert atlas.count(page+'\n') == 1, (root,page)
          print(f'Production atlas PASS: {len(root_pages)} actors x 232 = {len(root_pages)*232} frames')
          PY

      - name: Upload commit-ready production assets
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: actor-production-${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}-production/${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}.png
            build/${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}-production/game.atlas
            build/${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}-production/${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}-manifest.json
            build/ranged-readability.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Commit production assets to candidate branch
        env:
          ACTOR: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.actor }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="build/${ACTOR}-production"
          cp "$out/${ACTOR}.png" "assets/art/${ACTOR}.png"
          cp "$out/game.atlas" assets/art/game.atlas
          cp "$out/${ACTOR}-manifest.json" "assets/art/${ACTOR}-manifest.json"
          git config user.name "deadline-zero-art-bot"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "assets/art/${ACTOR}.png" assets/art/game.atlas "assets/art/${ACTOR}-manifest.json"
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "$ACTOR production assets already current"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "Stage qualified ${ACTOR} production atlas"
          target="${GITHUB_HEAD_REF:-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${target}"

## File: .github/workflows/android-test-release.yml
````yaml
name: Android Test APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/android-test-release.yml'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'

      - name: Install Android SDK 36
        run: sdkmanager 'platforms;android-36' 'build-tools;36.0.0'

      - name: Build test APK
        run: gradle :android:assembleDebug -PallowTestAds=true -PallowPlaceholderAssets=true

      - name: Prepare APK
        id: apk
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          src='android/build/outputs/apk/debug/android-debug.apk'
          test -s "$src"
          out="deadline-zero-test-${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}.apk"
          cp "$src" "$out"
          echo "path=$out" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          sha256sum "$out" | tee "${out}.sha256"

      - name: Upload workflow artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-test-apk-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
            ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Publish GitHub prerelease
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="android-test-${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}"
          apk='${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}'
          gh release create "$tag" \
            "$apk" "${apk}.sha256" \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --title "Deadline Zero Android Test #${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}" \
            --notes "APK de test Android généré automatiquement depuis main (${GITHUB_SHA}). Build debug pour test manuel uniquement." \
            --prerelease

## File: .github/workflows/deadline-zero-work-watch.yml
````yaml
name: Deadline Zero Work Watch

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: deadline-zero-work-watch
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  watch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check active work and recover stalled CI
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          active_count="$(
            gh api --paginate "repos/$GH_REPO/actions/runs?per_page=100"               --jq '[.workflow_runs[] | select(
                (.status == "queued" or .status == "in_progress" or .status == "pending")
                and (.name != "Deadline Zero Work Watch")
              )] | length' | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}'
          )"

          if [[ "$active_count" -gt 0 ]]; then
            echo "Creation/development work is active ($active_count workflow run(s)); no duplicate launch."
            exit 0
          fi

          open_pr="$(
            gh api "repos/$GH_REPO/pulls?state=open&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=1"               --jq '.[0] // empty'
          )"

          if [[ -n "$open_pr" ]]; then
            head_sha="$(jq -r '.head.sha' <<<"$open_pr")"
            pr_number="$(jq -r '.number' <<<"$open_pr")"
            echo "No active run; checking latest open PR #$pr_number ($head_sha)."

            failed_run_ids="$(
              gh api --paginate "repos/$GH_REPO/actions/runs?head_sha=$head_sha&per_page=100"                 --jq '.workflow_runs[]
                  | select(.name != "Deadline Zero Work Watch")
                  | select(.status == "completed")
                  | select(.conclusion == "failure" or .conclusion == "cancelled" or .conclusion == "timed_out")
                  | .id' | sort -u
            )"

            if [[ -n "$failed_run_ids" ]]; then
              while read -r run_id; do
                [[ -z "$run_id" ]] && continue
                echo "Re-running failed jobs for workflow run $run_id"
                gh api --method POST "repos/$GH_REPO/actions/runs/$run_id/rerun-failed-jobs"
              done <<<"$failed_run_ids"
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Open PR exists but has no failed workflow to recover. Push/PR triggers own the next deterministic step."
            exit 0
          fi

          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path

          contract = json.loads(Path("config/actor-production-contracts.json").read_text())
          layout = json.loads(Path("art_sources/final-sprite-layout.json").read_text())

          accepted = {
              name for name, entry in contract.get("actors", {}).items()
              if entry.get("status") == "accepted"
          }
          required = {entry["id"] for entry in layout.get("actors", [])}
          missing = sorted(required - accepted)

          print(f"Accepted final actors: {len(accepted & required)}/{len(required)}")
          if missing:
              print("Remaining authored actors:", ", ".join(missing))
              print(
                  "No open PR or active deterministic workflow exists. "
                  "A new authored-source/coding change is required; GitHub Actions cannot invent "
                  "that change without a configured coding agent."
              )
          else:
              print("Final actor contract is complete. No actor-production work to restart.")
          PY
````

## File: .github/workflows/enemy-source-catalog.yml
````yaml
name: Enemy Source Catalog

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/enemy-source-catalog.yml'
      - 'config/actor-production-contracts.json'
      - 'tools/blender/catalog_blend_actions.py'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  catalog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Resolve official Quaternius CC0 pack folder
        id: source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
          import re

          page='https://quaternius.com/packs/zombieapocalypsekit.html'
          html=urlopen(Request(page, headers={'User-Agent':'deadline-zero-enemy-catalog/1.0'}), timeout=30).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
          urls=list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"https://drive\.google\.com/drive/folders/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+[^'\" )<]*", html)))
          if not urls:
              raise SystemExit('Official Quaternius page no longer exposes a public Drive folder')
          Path('build').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          Path('build/source-folder.txt').write_text(urls[0]+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
          with open('/tmp/source-output','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
              f.write('folder='+urls[0]+'\n')
          print('Official source folder:', urls[0])
          PY
          cat /tmp/source-output >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Download official pack once
        env:
          SOURCE_FOLDER: ${{ steps.source.outputs.folder }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'gdown>=5.2,<6'
          mkdir -p build/quaternius-zombie-pack
          gdown --folder --remaining-ok "$SOURCE_FOLDER" -O build/quaternius-zombie-pack

      - name: Install Blender for structural source inspection
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y blender
          blender --version | head -n 1

      - name: Inspect native actions and structures
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/blend-inspection
          index=0
          while IFS= read -r -d '' blend; do
            out="build/blend-inspection/$(printf '%03d' "$index").json"
            echo "Inspecting $blend -> $out"
            blender -b "$blend" -P tools/blender/catalog_blend_actions.py -- --output "$out"
            python3 - "$out" "$blend" <<'PY'
          import json,sys
          from pathlib import Path
          path=Path(sys.argv[1])
          payload=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          payload['relative_path']=Path(sys.argv[2]).relative_to('build/quaternius-zombie-pack').as_posix()
          path.write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
          PY
            index=$((index+1))
          done < <(find build/quaternius-zombie-pack -type f -name '*.blend' -print0 | sort -z)
          test "$index" -gt 0

      - name: Build deterministic source catalog
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import hashlib, json

          root=Path('build/quaternius-zombie-pack')
          files=[p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
          inspection={}
          for p in sorted(Path('build/blend-inspection').glob('*.json')):
              row=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
              inspection[row['relative_path']]=row

          blends=[]
          textures=[]
          others=[]
          for p in sorted(files):
              rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
              size=p.stat().st_size
              row={'path':rel,'bytes':size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
              suffix=p.suffix.lower()
              if suffix == '.blend':
                  structural=inspection.get(rel)
                  if structural is None:
                      raise SystemExit(f'Missing Blender inspection for {rel}')
                  row.update({
                      'action_names':structural.get('action_names',[]),
                      'actions':structural.get('actions',[]),
                      'armatures':structural.get('armatures',[]),
                      'meshes':structural.get('meshes',[]),
                      'object_count':structural.get('object_count',0),
                  })
                  blends.append(row)
              elif suffix in {'.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.webp'}: textures.append(row)
              else: others.append(row)
          if not blends:
              raise SystemExit('No Blender masters found in official pack')
          payload={
              'source_page':'https://quaternius.com/packs/zombieapocalypsekit.html',
              'source_folder':Path('build/source-folder.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip(),
              'provider':'Quaternius',
              'pack':'Zombie Apocalypse Kit',
              'license':'CC0 1.0',
              'blend_count':len(blends),
              'texture_count':len(textures),
              'blends':blends,
              'textures':textures,
              'other_file_count':len(others),
          }
          Path('build/enemy-source-catalog.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
          print('Blend masters:', len(blends))
          for row in blends:
              print(row['path'], row['bytes'], row['sha256'])
              print('  actions:', ', '.join(row['action_names']) or '(none)')
          PY

      - name: Upload catalog evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: enemy-source-catalog-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/enemy-source-catalog.json
            build/source-folder.txt
            build/blend-inspection/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
````

name: Responsive UI QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  wide-phone-ui:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'
      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm
      - name: Capture 1536x691 responsive UI
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_2
          emulator-options: -no-snapshot -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -noaudio -no-boot-anim -camera-back none
          emulator-boot-timeout: 600
          disable-animations: true
          script: |
            set -eu
            adb wait-for-device
            timeout 300s bash -c 'until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r")" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done'
            gradle :android:installDebug :android:installDebugAndroidTest
            adb shell settings put secure immersive_mode_confirmations confirmed || true
            # Pixel 2 is naturally portrait. Force a 691x1536 physical display then rotate once so
            # the app receives the same ~1536x691 landscape aspect that failed on the real phone.
            adb shell wm size 691x1536
            adb shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0 || true
            adb shell settings put system user_rotation 1 || true
            sleep 2
            adb shell am force-stop com.deadlinezero.game || true
            timeout 5m adb shell am instrument -w -e deadlinezero.wideProbe true -e class com.deadlinezero.game.android.AndroidResponsiveUiVisualProbeTest#capturesWidePhoneMetaAndCombatScreens com.deadlinezero.game.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/responsive-ui-qa.txt
            grep -q 'OK (1 test)' /tmp/responsive-ui-qa.txt
            mkdir -p build/android-responsive-ui-qa
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-home.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-home.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-home.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-survivors.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-survivors.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-survivors.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-arsenal.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-arsenal.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-arsenal.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-settings.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-settings.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-settings.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-contract.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-contract.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-contract.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-combat.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-combat.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-combat.png
            adb shell wm size reset || true
      - name: Upload responsive UI visual QA
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-responsive-ui-qa-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/android-responsive-ui-qa/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

name: Rex Animation Smoke

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Rex Auto-Rig"]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rig_run_id:
        description: "Successful Rex Auto-Rig run ID"

  push:

      - "tools/blender/add_rex_rifle.py"
      - "tools/blender/validate_rex_weapon_visibility.py"
      - "tools/sprites/normalize_rex_frames.py"
permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
jobs:
  animate:
    if: >-
      ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Deadline Zero
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Resolve source rig run
        id: source
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.inputs.rig_run_id || '' }}
          TRIGGER_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id || '' }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail; run_id="$INPUT_RUN_ID"; [ -n "$run_id" ] || run_id="$TRIGGER_RUN_ID"
          if [ -z "$run_id" ]; then response="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/rex-auto-rig.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=1")"; run_id="$(printf '%s' "$response" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin).get("workflow_runs",[]); print(r[0]["id"] if r else "")')"; fi
          test -n "$run_id"; echo "run_id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Download rig artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          run-id: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          path: rig-artifact
      - name: Locate rigged Rex
        run: rig="$(find rig-artifact -type f -name rex_rigged.glb -print -quit)"; test -n "$rig"; echo "REX_RIG=$rig" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install Blender runtime
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y blender libgl1 libegl1 python3-numpy python3-pil
      - name: Repair Rex skin weights
        run: mkdir -p build/rex-animation && blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/repair_rex_weights.py -- --input "$REX_RIG" --output build/rex-animation/rex_repaired.glb --report build/rex-animation/weight-repair-report.json
      - name: Apply Rex premium palette
        run: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/style_rex_materials.py -- --input build/rex-animation/rex_repaired.glb --output build/rex-animation/rex_styled.glb
      - name: Attach separate Rex rifle
        run: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/add_rex_rifle.py -- --input build/rex-animation/rex_styled.glb --output build/rex-animation/rex_armed.glb && test -s build/rex-animation/rex_armed.glb
      - name: Build deterministic Rex actions
        run: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/build_rex_actions.py -- --input build/rex-animation/rex_armed.glb --output build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend
      - name: Refine rifle firing attack
        run: blender -b build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/refine_rex_rifle_attack.py -- --output build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend
      - name: Validate weapon visibility
        run: blender -b build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/validate_rex_weapon_visibility.py -- --report build/rex-animation/weapon-visibility-report.json --size 512
      - name: Render 8-direction masters
        run: blender -b build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py -- --actor rex --output build/rex-animation/rendered --size 512 && test "$(find build/rex-animation/rendered -type f -name '*.png' | wc -l)" -eq 232
      - name: Normalize to 96px and run sprite QA
        run: python3 tools/sprites/normalize_rex_frames.py --input build/rex-animation/rendered --output build/rex-animation/normalized96 --report build/rex-animation/sprite-qa-report.json --contact-sheet build/rex-animation/rex-phone-contact-sheet.png
      - name: Build render manifest

          root=Path('build/rex-animation/normalized96'); files=sorted(root.rglob('*.png')); qa=json.loads(Path('build/rex-animation/sprite-qa-report.json').read_text()); weapon=json.loads(Path('build/rex-animation/weapon-visibility-report.json').read_text())
          p={'actor':'rex','stage':'armed-styled-phone-scale-animation-smoke','production_ready':False,'frame_count':len(files),'expected_frame_count':232,'render_size':[96,96],'qa_pass':qa['pass'],'weapon_visibility_pass':weapon['pass'],'palette':'navy-black-cyan-orange','weapon':'separate-procedural-rifle-v2','attack_motion':'rifle-fire-v2','files':[{'path':str(f.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for f in files]}
          Path('build/rex-animation/render-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2)+'\n'); assert len(files)==232 and qa['pass'] and weapon['pass']
          PY
      - name: Upload animation smoke artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rex-animation-smoke-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/rex-animation/rex_armed.glb

          if-no-files-found: error

## File: .github/workflows/rex-auto-rig.yml
````yaml
name: Rex Auto-Rig

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_path:
        description: "Path to Rex GLB in repository"
        required: false
        default: "art_sources/rex/master/rex_source.glb"
      source_url:
        description: "Optional HTTPS URL used when source_path is absent"
        required: false
        default: ""
  push:
    paths:
      - "art_sources/rex/master/rex_source.glb"
      - "art_sources/rex/master/source-url.txt"
      - "art_sources/rex/master/proxy_parts/**"
      - "art_sources/rex/master/proxy-manifest.json"
      - ".github/workflows/rex-auto-rig.yml"
      - "tools/blender/validate_rig.py"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  rig:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      SOURCE_PATH: ${{ github.event.inputs.source_path || 'art_sources/rex/master/rex_source.glb' }}
      SOURCE_URL_INPUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.source_url || '' }}
      HD_SHA256: 43c2bffdcbcbacd59327bef34b2a71ef2afbebbe5d032ecfadedbd109f717d17
      PROXY_SHA256: 1672041817d8c85da094436a1b21087adf4f19d12e672f20987fa5a9770695ac
      MOTIUS_COMMIT: 5d98709adcb02c7f668019f96d89be39b90e4c05

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Deadline Zero
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Resolve Rex source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          resolved=""
          expected=""
          kind=""

          if [ -s "$SOURCE_PATH" ]; then
            resolved="$SOURCE_PATH"
            expected="$HD_SHA256"
            kind="hd"
          else
            url="$SOURCE_URL_INPUT"
            if [ -z "$url" ] && [ -s art_sources/rex/master/source-url.txt ]; then
              url="$(tr -d '\r\n' < art_sources/rex/master/source-url.txt)"
            fi

            if [ -n "$url" ]; then
              case "$url" in
                https://*) ;;
                *) echo "::error::Rex source URL must use HTTPS"; exit 2 ;;
              esac
              mkdir -p build/rex-source
              resolved="build/rex-source/rex_source.glb"
              curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --max-time 180 \
                --output "$resolved" "$url"
              expected="$HD_SHA256"
              kind="hd-url"
            elif compgen -G 'art_sources/rex/master/proxy_parts/part*.b64' > /dev/null; then
              mkdir -p build/rex-source
              cat art_sources/rex/master/proxy_parts/part*.b64 > build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb.xz.b64
              base64 --decode build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb.xz.b64 > build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb.xz
              xz --decompress --stdout build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb.xz > build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb
              resolved="build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb"
              expected="$PROXY_SHA256"
              kind="proxy"
            else
              echo "::error::No Rex HD source, URL, or embedded proxy is available"
              exit 2
            fi
          fi

          test -s "$resolved"
          actual="$(sha256sum "$resolved" | awk '{print $1}')"
          if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
            echo "::error::Rex source SHA-256 mismatch: expected $expected, got $actual"
            exit 3
          fi

          echo "REX_SOURCE=$resolved" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "REX_SOURCE_KIND=$kind" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          sha256sum "$resolved" | tee rex-source.sha256
          file "$resolved"
          echo "Resolved Rex source kind: $kind"

      - name: Install Blender runtime
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y blender libgl1 libegl1 xz-utils python3-numpy
          blender --version | head -n 2
          blender -b --factory-startup --python-expr "import numpy as np; print('Blender NumPy', np.__version__)"

      - name: Fetch pinned Motius template rigger
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git init .motius
          git -C .motius remote add origin https://github.com/ZeyuLing/Motius.git
          git -C .motius sparse-checkout init --cone
          git -C .motius sparse-checkout set motius/motion/rigging
          git -C .motius fetch --depth 1 origin "$MOTIUS_COMMIT"
          git -C .motius checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
          test -s .motius/motius/motion/rigging/_blender.py
          test -s .motius/motius/motion/rigging/template.py

      - name: Auto-rig Rex with deterministic Motius template
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/rex-autorig
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          root = Path.cwd()
          output = (root / "build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb").resolve()
          manifest = Path(f"{output}.json")
          job = {
              "schema_version": 1,
              "method": "template",
              "character_path": str((root / os.environ["REX_SOURCE"]).resolve()),
              "output_path": str(output),
              "manifest_path": str(manifest),
              "template_module": str((root / ".motius/motius/motion/rigging/template.py").resolve()),
              "up_axis": "auto",
              "replace_existing_rig": False,
              "weight_method": "capsules",
              "config": {
                  "top_k": 4,
                  "weight_falloff": 1.75,
                  "side_penalty": 0.025,
                  "chunk_size": 16384,
              },
          }
          Path("build/rex-autorig/template-job.json").write_text(
              json.dumps(job, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
          )
          PY

          blender --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 \
            --python .motius/motius/motion/rigging/_blender.py -- \
            --job build/rex-autorig/template-job.json

          test -s build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb
          test -s build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb.json
          sha256sum build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb | tee build/rex-autorig/rex-rigged.sha256

      - name: Validate rig and render previews
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          blender -b --python tools/blender/validate_rig.py -- \
            --input build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb \
            --output build/rex-autorig/validation

      - name: Add report to job summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "## Rex auto-rig" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Source kind: ${REX_SOURCE_KIND:-unresolved}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Method: template (Motius $MOTIUS_COMMIT)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ -f rex-source.sha256 ]; then
            echo '```text' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            cat rex-source.sha256 >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
          if [ -f build/rex-autorig/validation/rig-report.json ]; then
            echo '### Structural validation' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo '```json' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            cat build/rex-autorig/validation/rig-report.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - name: Upload rig artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rex-auto-rig-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            rex-source.sha256
            build/rex-source/
            build/rex-autorig/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

## File: .github/workflows/rex-publish-current.yml
````yaml
name: Publish Validated Rex

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      animation_run_id:
        description: "Successful Rex Animation Smoke run ID (defaults to latest successful)"
        required: false
        default: ""
  push:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/rex-publish-current.yml"
      - "tools/sprites/upsert_directional_actor_atlas.py"

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Deadline Zero
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Resolve validated animation run
        id: source
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.inputs.animation_run_id || '' }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          run_id="$INPUT_RUN_ID"
          if [ -z "$run_id" ]; then
            response="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/rex-animation-smoke.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=1")"
            run_id="$(printf '%s' "$response" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin).get("workflow_runs",[]); print(r[0]["id"] if r else "")')"
          fi
          test -n "$run_id"
          echo "run_id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Download validated Rex artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          run-id: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          path: rex-artifact

      - name: Locate and verify sprite source
        id: sprites
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$(find rex-artifact -type d -name normalized96 -print -quit)"
          manifest="$(find rex-artifact -type f -name render-manifest.json -print -quit)"
          qa="$(find rex-artifact -type f -name sprite-qa-report.json -print -quit)"
          test -n "$root" -a -n "$manifest" -a -n "$qa"
          python3 - "$manifest" "$qa" <<'PY'
          import json,sys
          manifest=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); qa=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
          assert manifest.get('frame_count') == 232
          assert manifest.get('qa_pass') is True
          assert manifest.get('weapon_visibility_pass') is True
          assert qa.get('pass') is True and qa.get('frame_count') == 232
          PY
          echo "root=$root" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "manifest=$manifest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Install atlas tooling
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3-pil

      - name: Upsert production Rex atlas page
        env:
          SPRITE_ROOT: ${{ steps.sprites.outputs.root }}
          SOURCE_MANIFEST: ${{ steps.sprites.outputs.manifest }}
          SOURCE_RUN_ID: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/sprites/upsert_directional_actor_atlas.py \
            --actor rex \
            --root survivor/rex \
            --input "$SPRITE_ROOT" \
            --atlas assets/art/game.atlas \
            --png assets/art/rex.png \
            --manifest assets/art/rex-manifest.json \
            --source-manifest "$SOURCE_MANIFEST" \
            --source-run-id "$SOURCE_RUN_ID"

      - name: Verify Rex production regions and preserved pages
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          atlas=Path('assets/art/game.atlas').read_text()
          dirs=('n','ne','e','se','s','sw','w','nw')
          anims={'idle':4,'run':8,'attack':6,'hit':3,'death':8}
          for d in dirs:
              for anim,count in anims.items():
                  got=atlas.count(f'survivor/rex/{d}/{anim}\n')
                  assert got == count, (d,anim,got,count)
          assert Path('assets/art/rex.png').is_file()
          print('Rex atlas contract PASS; existing non-Rex pages preserved by upsert publisher')
          PY

      - name: Commit Rex atlas to main
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "deadline-zero-art-bot"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add assets/art/rex.png assets/art/game.atlas assets/art/rex-manifest.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Atlas already current"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "Publish validated Rex production atlas"
          git push origin HEAD:main
````

name: Shambler Android Acceptance

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Publish Validated Shambler"]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: shambler-android-acceptance
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  android-visual:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout published main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main

      - name: Verify published Shambler assets are present
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s assets/art/rex.png
          test -s assets/art/shambler.png
          test -s assets/art/shambler-manifest.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          atlas=Path('assets/art/game.atlas').read_text()
          manifest=json.loads(Path('assets/art/shambler-manifest.json').read_text())
          assert manifest['actor'] == 'shambler', manifest
          assert manifest['frame_count'] == 232, manifest
          dirs=('n','ne','e','se','s','sw','w','nw')
          anims={'idle':4,'run':8,'attack':6,'hit':3,'death':8}
          for root in ('survivor/rex','enemy/shambler'):
              for d in dirs:
                  for anim,count in anims.items():
                      got=atlas.count(f'{root}/{d}/{anim}\n')
                      assert got == count, (root,d,anim,got,count)
          print('Published atlas contract PASS: Rex 232 + Shambler 232')
          PY

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'

      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm

      - name: Validate published Rex + Shambler in Android gameplay
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_2
          emulator-options: -no-snapshot -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -noaudio -no-boot-anim -camera-back none
          disable-animations: true
          script: |
            gradle :android:installDebug :android:installDebugAndroidTest -PallowTestAds=true -PallowPlaceholderAssets=true
            adb shell settings put secure immersive_mode_confirmations confirmed || true
            adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.deadlinezero.game.android.AndroidGameplayVisualProbeTest#capturesRexGameplayAndAttackFrames com.deadlinezero.game.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/shambler-acceptance.txt
            grep -q 'OK (1 test)' /tmp/shambler-acceptance.txt
            mkdir -p build/shambler-android-acceptance
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-gameplay.png
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-shambler-crowd.png
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-attack.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-gameplay.png build/shambler-android-acceptance/rex-gameplay.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-shambler-crowd.png build/shambler-android-acceptance/rex-shambler-crowd.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-attack.png build/shambler-android-acceptance/rex-attack.png
            test -s build/shambler-android-acceptance/rex-gameplay.png
            test -s build/shambler-android-acceptance/rex-shambler-crowd.png
            test -s build/shambler-android-acceptance/rex-attack.png

      - name: Upload Shambler Android acceptance evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: shambler-android-acceptance-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/shambler-android-acceptance/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

## File: .github/workflows/shambler-animation-smoke.yml
````yaml
name: Shambler Animation Smoke
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/shambler-animation-smoke.yml'
      - 'tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py'
      - 'tools/sprites/normalize_actor_frames.py'

jobs:
  render:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Download locked CC0 Shambler source
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'gdown>=5.2,<6'
          mkdir -p build/shambler-source/Textures
          gdown 'https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1MR_TE1FwriGLRKjJYLvsgJNOtYZDs1mu' -O build/shambler-source/Zombie_Basic.blend
          gdown 'https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1f4CRjRp4V7p7XIRo0X-DXpYc2AoMx7S7' -O build/shambler-source/Zombie_Atlas.png
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import hashlib, shutil
          expected={
            'Zombie_Basic.blend':'d13e073d52255d6a8a43160c6452755358c5a6cbbf900f2526359f113d8ed6ce',
            'Zombie_Atlas.png':'8803e5543d5e6b6f66aa41a5ef93e6c2ffb77b5476d0202296d2f4c8f4eb9e8d',
          }
          root=Path('build/shambler-source')
          for name,want in expected.items():
              got=hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
              print(name, got)
              if got != want: raise SystemExit(f'SHA mismatch for {name}')
          shutil.copy2(root/'Zombie_Atlas.png', root/'Textures'/'Atlas_Zombie.png')
          PY
      - name: Install Blender and image tooling
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y blender libegl1 libgl1-mesa-dri
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'Pillow>=10,<12'
          blender --version | head -n 1
          ldconfig -p | grep -F 'libEGL.so.1'
      - name: Render native Shambler actions into exact contract
        run: |
          # Native Death contains substantial root motion. Render with a wider
          # orthographic field so the master frames preserve the entire fall;
          # the fixed-transform normalizer restores phone-scale occupancy later.
          blender -b build/shambler-source/Zombie_Basic.blend \
            -P tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py -- \
            --actor shambler \
            --output build/shambler/master512 \
            --target-height 0.58 \
            --ortho-scale 3.25 \
            --idle-action Idle \
            --run-action Walk \
            --attack-action Punch \
            --hit-action HitReact \
            --death-action Death
          test "$(find build/shambler/master512 -name '*.png' | wc -l)" -eq 232
          mkdir -p build/shambler/debug512
          for d in n ne e se s sw w nw; do
            cp "build/shambler/master512/idle/$d/idle_00.png" "build/shambler/debug512/${d}_idle_00.png"
          done
      - name: Validate master render margins
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from PIL import Image
          import json

          root=Path('build/shambler/master512')
          report=Path('build/shambler/master-margin.json')
          required=4
          frames=sorted(root.rglob('*.png'))
          offenders=[]
          empty=[]
          min_margin=10**9
          for path in frames:
              img=Image.open(path).convert('RGBA')
              bbox=img.getchannel('A').getbbox()
              rel=str(path.relative_to(root))
              if bbox is None:
                  empty.append(rel)
                  continue
              left, top, right, bottom=bbox
              margins={
                  'left':left,
                  'top':top,
                  'right':img.width-right,
                  'bottom':img.height-bottom,
              }
              min_margin=min(min_margin,*margins.values())
              bad={k:v for k,v in margins.items() if v < required}
              if bad:
                  offenders.append({'frame':rel,'bbox':[left,top,right,bottom],'margins':margins,'violations':bad})
          payload={
              'pass':len(frames)==232 and not empty and not offenders,
              'frame_count':len(frames),
              'required_margin_px':required,
              'minimum_observed_margin_px':None if min_margin==10**9 else min_margin,
              'empty_frames':empty,
              'offenders':offenders,
          }
          report.write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n')
          print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in payload.items() if k!='offenders'},indent=2))
          if offenders:
              print('Master clipping offenders (first 20):')
              for item in offenders[:20]: print(item)
          if not payload['pass']:
              raise SystemExit('Master-render margin QA failed')
          PY
      - name: Normalize and validate phone-scale frames
        run: |
          # Center the complete per-direction motion envelope rather than the raw
          # source camera center. This keeps asymmetric native root motion (Death)
          # intact without allowing the 96px output crop to cut it off.
          python3 tools/sprites/normalize_actor_frames.py \
            --actor shambler \
            --input build/shambler/master512 \
            --output build/shambler/normalized96 \
            --report build/shambler/qa.json \
            --contact-sheet build/shambler/shambler-phone-contact-sheet.png \
            --horizontal-anchor union-center
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          q=json.loads(Path('build/shambler/qa.json').read_text())
          assert q['pass'] is True, q
          assert q['frame_count'] == 232, q
          assert q['horizontal_anchor'] == 'union-center', q
          print('Shambler sprite QA PASS:', q['frame_count'], 'frames, scale', q['scale'])
          PY
      - name: Write render manifest
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json
          manifest={
            'actor':'shambler',
            'source':'Quaternius Zombie Apocalypse Kit / Zombie_Basic.blend',
            'license':'CC0 1.0',
            'source_sha256':'d13e073d52255d6a8a43160c6452755358c5a6cbbf900f2526359f113d8ed6ce',
            'texture_sha256':'8803e5543d5e6b6f66aa41a5ef93e6c2ffb77b5476d0202296d2f4c8f4eb9e8d',
            'frame_count':232,
            'cell':[96,96],
            'source_render':[512,512],
            'ortho_scale':3.25,
            'horizontal_anchor':'union-center',
            'directions':['n','ne','e','se','s','sw','w','nw'],
            'animations':{'idle':4,'run':8,'attack':6,'hit':3,'death':8},
            'action_map':{'idle':'Idle','run':'Walk','attack':'Punch','hit':'HitReact','death':'Death'},
            'production_ready':False,
            'stage':'first-native-animation-vertical-slice-candidate',
          }
          Path('build/shambler/render-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
          PY
      - name: Upload Shambler animation smoke
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: shambler-animation-smoke-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/shambler/normalized96/
            build/shambler/qa.json
            build/shambler/master-margin.json
            build/shambler/shambler-phone-contact-sheet.png
            build/shambler/render-manifest.json
            build/shambler/debug512/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
````
